state_background_check.value: No — Utah's constitution bars convicted felons from holding office in the state until their right is restored (after 10 years, full sentence completion, and restitution), but doesn't operate as a candidate disclosure form the way some other states' do, and the U.S. Constitution's own qualifications for Congress (age, citizenship, residency) can't be added to by any state, so this doesn't reach U.S. House or Senate candidates
state_background_check.snippet: Utah Const. Art. IV, § 6: "Any mentally incompetent person, any person convicted of a felony, or any person convicted of treason or a crime against the elective franchise, may not be permitted to vote at any election or be eligible to hold office in this State until the right to vote or hold elective office is restored as provided by statute." Congressional qualifications are set exclusively by the U.S. Constitution, confirmed per https://www.everycrsreport.com/reports/R41946.html: "the Framers intended the Constitution to be the exclusive source of qualifications for Members of Congress, and that the Framers thereby 'divested' States of any power to add qualifications."

enacted_laws.title: Providing for congressional disapproval under chapter 8 of title 5, United States Code, of the rule submitted by the National Park Service relating to "Glen Canyon National Recreation Area: Motor Vehicles".
enacted_laws.summary: This joint resolution allows off-road vehicles to be used in certain areas of the Glen Canyon National Recreation Area, which is in northern Arizona and southeastern Utah and contains Lake Powell. Specifically, the joint resolution nullifies the rule issued by the National Park Service (NPS) titled Glen Canyon National Recreation Area; Motor Vehicles  and published on January 13, 2025. Under the rule, the NPS limited the use of off-road vehicles, such as off-highway vehicles and all-terrain vehicles, in certain areas. For instance, the rule prohibited the use of off-road vehicles on an 8-mile segment of the Poison Spring Loop located on Route 633 proceeding north to Route 730 in the Orange Cliffs Special Management Unit. The rule also eliminated the authority of the NPS to open the upper portion of the Flint Trail in that unit to off-road vehicles. Additionally, the rule limited off-road vehicle use from certain roads to the shoreline of the lake.

enacted_laws.title: Utah State Parks Adjustment Act
enacted_laws.summary: Utah State Parks Adjustment Act This act requires the Bureau of Land Management and the Forest Service to convey certain federal lands to Utah for inclusion in the following Utah State Parks: Antelope Island State Park, Wasatch Mountain State Park, and Fremont Indian State Park. Utah must use the lands for public purposes, including parks, campgrounds, recreation, and permitted livestock grazing.  Utah must also cover any costs relating to the conveyances for the Antelope Island State Park and the Wasatch Mountain State Park, including costs for surveys and other administrative costs. As a condition of the conveyance to the Fremont Indian State Park, the Forest Service must (1) reserve easements to the conveyed land to be included in Fremont Indian State Park for all National Forest System roads and trails that originate at, terminate at, or traverse the conveyed land; and (2) convey to Utah only certain water rights that provide water to the Castle Rock Campground and the Belknap Historic Guard Station interpretive site. The act also authorizes the Forest Service to enter into an agreement with Utah with respect to additional terms and conditions applicable to the conveyance, such as maintenance of roads and trails.

platform.value: Repeal legal-tender coercion and end capital-gains penalty on gold and silver. Open the Federal Reserve's books to independent external audit. Return the power to create money to Congress. Re-anchor the currency to a commodity standard over time.
platform.snippet: Repeal the legal-tender coercion (31 U.S.C. § 5103) and end the capital-gains penalty on gold and silver, so honest money can compete on a level field. Restore honest banking — true-safekeeping law for demand deposits and the right of full-reserve banks to exist and compete. Re-anchor the currency to a commodity standard over time, so the money supply answers to reality rather than to those who manage it.

platform.value: Create the Make Americans Wealthy Again account allowing after-tax dollars up to $10,000 per year per person with no income tests or penalties. Index every contribution and capital asset basis for inflation so only real profit is taxed, not inflation-driven phantom gains. Restore pre-1982 first-in, first-out ordering for annuity withdrawals.
platform.snippet: Create the Make Americans Wealthy Again account: after-tax dollars, up to $10,000 a year per person (indexed from enactment), open to every American from birth — no income tests, no penalties, no required distributions. Index every contribution and everything it earns from the day it is made, and let withdrawals come out first-in, first-out at full indexed value — so your own principal returns untaxed and only real profit is ever taxed. Index the basis of every capital asset for inflation, so the IRS taxes the real gain and never again the phantom. Count interest honestly — tax only the real component, the nominal interest minus the year s inflation, floored at zero. Restore the pre-1982 first-in, first-out ordering for annuity withdrawals, repealing the gains-first rule that puts the taxman ahead of the saver s own principal.

platform.value: End tax advantage tying health coverage to employment by equalizing tax treatment of health dollars. Re-legalize real catastrophic insurance and allow plans to be sold across state lines. Restore up-front pricing with Direct Primary Care and cash medicine. Fund care of genuinely uninsurable directly and visibly. End mandates forcing routine, low-cost care through insurance.
platform.snippet: Unchain your coverage from your job — end the 1943 tax trick by equalizing the tax treatment of health dollars, so the cash you spend on your own plan, your own doctor, and your own Health Savings Account is as tax-free as your employer s premium. Re-legalize real insurance: cheap, lean, catastrophic coverage for the rare disaster, plus the guaranteed-renewable and health-status plans that protect people before they get sick — sold across state lines, so 900 little fiefdoms have to compete for you. Restore the price tag — plain, honest, up-front pricing, with Direct Primary Care and cash medicine unleashed so a patient can read the price before he buys. Make mercy honest — fund the care of the genuinely uninsurable directly and visibly, not buried inside everyone s premium where no one can see the subsidy, vote on it, or cap it. Get Washington out of Box 1 and Box 3 — end the mandates that force routine, low-cost, high-frequency care through the insurance mechanism in the first place.

bio_summary.value: Kent Stewart Udell was born in Lehi, Utah, and raised in a large Latter-day Saint family, where values of service, integrity, and community were central. Over his career as a Mechanical Engineer, he worked directly with the mining, petroleum, geothermal, and solar industries which has given him invaluable firsthand understanding of the livelihoods, concerns, and aspirations of working families across the West. Much of his focus has been on complex water issues, environmental remediation, developing sustainable energy alternatives and educating the next generation of engineers.
